_comment: Unity 6 (6000.4.11f1). UGUI 2.0 already includes TextMeshPro. For textured GLB models add "com.unity.cloud.gltfast" via Window > Package Manager (Add package by name), then run GKMC > Enable glTFast (GKMC_GLTFAST). Without it, models load from a Resources folder or fall back to procedural primitives.
